# Challenge 005: Flight cancellation rebooking

This challenge asks `content.md` to replace a vague, upbeat disruption card
shown after an airline cancels a flight and offers a replacement. The rewrite
must state the cancellation, explain the replacement flight and its effects,
and preserve the person's choice to accept it, choose another flight, or
request a refund.

The scenario, candidate, deterministic diagnosis, and separate Claude/Cursor
review packets are synthetic English-only evaluation material. They are not
approved product content, benchmark gold, or evidence of product
effectiveness.
